ops.title: Revalidate rewritten PR-card replacements under the posting lock
ops.description:
Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali, implementation owner of this branch.
Evidence: cmd/cc-slack/prlinks.go:403-410 chooses a predecessor before placePRCards takes cards.mu at :432; :435-471 posts every selected replacement without checking whether another call has already posted its successor. ReplacedBy is assigned later at :485, after tellShown at :378. The daemon dispatches handlers without acquiring the supplied RepoLock (cc-interact v0.40.6 daemon/server.go:570-590).
Failing interleaving: two tap_prs posts select the same answered card before either enters the posting critical section; both then post a fresh card, and both replace the old card's successor link.
Next step: add a deterministic overlapping-post regression in prlinks_test.go, then revalidate the predecessor/current successor under cards.mu and persist the replacement relation with the fresh card. Keep Slack redraws after unlocking.

ops.text: Two overlapping tap_prs posts for the same answered card and changed line create exactly one fresh waiting card and one stable predecessor link.
Later posts and redraws reuse the fresh card; CI runs the regression with the race detector. No local test suite during this review.
